records.original_sql: SELECT (SELECT nonce FROM ex.data.cache_nonce) = (SELECT v FROM first);
records.reason: The nonce can remain equal only when the unsupported persistent disk tier serves the entry after the memory cap evicts it.

records.original_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 FROM duckdb_logs() WHERE type = 'VGI' AND message LIKE '%result_cache.hit%';
records.reason: This assertion specifically requires a disk-tier cache hit; the DataFusion adapter currently provides a bounded session-memory tier only.
